thread:
Maya: Quick heads up from usability: people think the roles matrix edit button changes org-wide roles, not just the invite default. We need clearer affordance. Noah: Can you paste the screenshot? Maya: https://redwood-assets/screens/roles-matrix-confuse.png — the edit icon sits right next to the org name. Olivia: Simple fix: move the edit control into the row actions and add microcopy: 'Default role for new invites'. Paul: Also accessibility: when you open the role editor modal, screen reader reads 'Dialog' but not the title. Add aria-labelledby and ensure focus lands on the title. Designbot: Uploaded mock v1: https://redwood-assets/mocks/roles-row-actions-v1.png — shows moved edit + helper text. Noah: Audit note: CS wants a link from a role-change event to the roles screen with the changed row highlighted. Deep-link scheme `?highlight=role:`. Maya: Good. UX copy suggestion for the helper: 'This sets the default role applied when inviting new members.' Shorten on mobile: 'Default role for new members'. Olivia: I'll add ARIA snippet to the PR:
and include focus restore. Paul: Emit analytics: `role_default_edit_opened`, `role_default_saved`. Include `org_id` and `from_ui` tag. Maya: Can someone take a tiny PR for copy + moving control + aria? Assigning @Noah. Noah: On it, will include unit + keyboard e2e. ETA today. Designbot: Reminder: show this flow in the design review at 11am. Maya: Thanks — I'll add the usability notes to the review thread and tag CS.
